_comment: Shared LPC humanoid animation layout. All humanoid entities (player, cop, future NPCs) reference this file. The texture field is unused at runtime - LPC entities have their texture set by AppearanceOps::resolveAppearance from layered PNGs in assets/sprites/lpc/assembled/. Frame layout: 64x64 frames, 4 directions (S/W/E/N), 6 state rows (idle/walk/attack/hit/death/run), 8 frames per direction block.
